notes: Layer of the synthesis pipeline is the main ambiguity. It is a multi-agent loop with judge feedback, which could read as a Harness workflow (TSK or GH). Chosen LLM side because its outputs (ST-Align, ST-Bench, ST-SFT, ST-RL) are training and evaluation data for the model (R2 boundary). ST-Bench is not a separate module: it is produced by the pipeline and used for training and held-out testing (R1 excludes evaluation datasets of a method paper). Zero-shot CausalRivers test (L763-L768) is evaluation only. Cost columns are not decision utility. Graph enters only as a text prompt (L389-L390), so it is not a separate module.
